findings.claim: The second string-key collection path has its duplicate guard inverted: it adds an entry only when that key is already present, so ordinary unique string keys are omitted and duplicate keys still reach Dictionary.Add and can throw. This breaks both analysis and generation for affected types.

The duplicate case should report MsgPack005 without an analyzer exception, and the unique-key case should retain both collected members.

findings.claim: MsgPack017 is incorrectly classified as AOT-only and deliberately suppressed. Its documented warning concerns an init-property initializer being replaced during deserialization, which also applies when the suppressed type is serialized dynamically; omitting it removes a runtime contract warning rather than merely a formatter-generation check.

receipt_plan.detail: Cite ledger [L6] and doc/analyzers/MsgPack017.md: the diagnostic describes deserialization replacing the initializer's default, not a generated-formatter-only restriction.
